div.div: Follow the arrows: 8 steps from choosing a partner to a launched ERP. Dates from the Go-Live Master Plan.

div.div:
1 · CHOOSE THE PARTNER
JAN – JUN 2025
Evaluated 2 vendors (Jan–Feb) ·
HRIS demo deep-dive (Mar 4) ·
kickoff with chosen partner (APR 23) ·
roadmap & cost approved by mgmt (JUN 20)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 105px; margin-left: 361px;

div.div:
2 · CONFIGURE & BUILD
JUL 26 – OCT 13
QA server set up · vendor configures
the system to our processes ·
weekly syncs · access roles drafted

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 105px; margin-left: 671px;

div.div:
3 · PILOT TEST
OCT 6 – 17
Small group tries the real system
on the Dev server · HRIS pilot 2 weeks ·
Helpdesk pilot keeps running to DEC 19

OCT 20 – DEC 19
Old process and Odoo run side-by-side
(QA, then Gold server) · weekly checkpoints ·
fixes & report calibration all the way

5 · ANNOUNCE & TRAIN EVERYONE
DEC 1 – 19
Launch announced DEC 1 · system moves
to the Gold server · Head Office & Field
Operations trained (DEC 2–19) ·
Dept Heads session DEC 12

6 · CUTOVER
DEC 12 – 19
Gold converted to the Prod server (DEC 12) ·
rollback plan ready · DEC 19: all-in data
migration + parallel run ends

GO / NO-GO
prod ready ·
data verified

7 · LAUNCH
JAN 5, 2026
HRIS & Helpdesk ERP launch ·
Accounting live · everyone works
in the new system from day one

JAN – FEB 2026
Daily support through January ·
HO & FO refresher trainings ·
projects closed FEB 2026 —
maintenance mode begins

div.div: Why it worked: nobody met the system for the first time at launch. Users piloted it in October, ran it side-by-side with the old process for 9 weeks, the data was migrated 8 times in rehearsal before the real one — and go-live day was the 9th.
